newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber on disk drive makers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber on disk drive makers.

text.p: -- PaineWebber Inc analyst Paul Weinstein said he raised estimates on Western Digital Corp based on stronger than expected gross margins for desktop computer drives.
-- In written research, he raised the March quarter to $1.50 a share from $1.40 and the June Quarter to $1.57 a share from $1.52. Full year 1997 went to $5.14 a share from $5.00.

-- Weinstein also said he is comfortable Quantum Corp can meet or exceed his earnings estimate of $0.90 a share versus $0.35 on year ago for the March quarter. He said Quantum continues to suggest it is sold out on all product families and the tone of demand is very strong.
-- Lastly, Weinsten said his confidence in Seagate's business for the March Quarter is rising despite concerns about an easing of the shortage of desktop drives.

-- He said Seagate continues to face very tight allocation of its high end disk drives. Desktop drives also are on allocation. Weinstein expects Seagate to catch up with the shortage by this summer, but says the company many not be able to satisfy as much as $100 million worth of demand for desktop products in the current quarter.
-- Weinstein said he is maintaining Seagate's earnings estimates for now, until the quarterly picture is clearer. But he added he has a bias toward the upside.
